name: alpaca
description: A lightweight issue tracker built entirely inside WordPress, designed for developers and agencies managing client projects.
author: Rareview®

scripts.zip: rm -f alpaca-issue-tracker.zip && npm run build && zip -r alpaca-issue-tracker.zip . -x '*.git*' '*.github/*' '*.DS_Store' '*node_modules*' 'vendor/autoload.php' 'vendor/bin/*' 'vendor/composer/*' 'vendor/dealerdirect/*' 'vendor/phpcompatibility/*' 'vendor/phpcsstandards/*' 'vendor/squizlabs/*' 'vendor/wp-coding-standards/*' '.build/*' '.build/**' '.distignore' '.wordpress-org/*' '.wordpress-org/**' 'documentation/*' 'documentation/**' 'docs/*' 'docs/**' 'playground/*' 'playground/**' 'src/*' 'scripts/*' 'scripts/**' '*.parcel-cache*' '*.cache*' '*package*.json' '*composer.*' '*.xml' '.*rc.json' 'AGENTS.md' 'README.md' 'alpaca-issue-tracker.zip' 'dist/*.map' '*.backup'
scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:styles && npm run lint:php
scripts.format: npm run format:js && npm run format:php
scripts.fix: npm run fix:js && npm run fix:styles && npm run fix:php
scripts.clb: npm run clear && npm run lint && npm run build
